svg.title: Team OTEL tab
svg.text: Members: 7 · Repositories: 4 · access: restricted · you: manager
Includes 46 calls received in realtime and not yet confirmed by the hook's regular upload — totals may still change.
team repositories · Claude Code per-call estimate (cost_usd) · by event.timestamp
click a legend item to hide / show it
model → person → repository · same period and filters as the chart
Top 5 people by cost, the rest folded into "others (N)". "Branch" replaces the last column with repository · branch (the session's branch).
Hover a band or a node: cost, share, calls, sessions. People the caller may not see are not in any column (see 3).
click a row: filter the whole tab to this person
click a row: open that repository's OTEL tab in this team
A session linked to several of these repositories counts in each row, so the cost column may add up to more than the team total.
Same realtime badge / notices / slow-update banner rules as the repository tab (FR-22, FR-32), over the team's sessions
Last column: repository, or repository · branch (branch = the session's git branch); a session linked to two team repositories counts once in totals
Access = the Analytics rule: restricted team → owner and managers only (tab hidden for a plain member or an ADLC trainer without manager; a direct link → No access); transparent → everyone
New route GET /api/v1/teams/:teamId/otel/facts — the repository facts shape plus people[] and repositories[], read from the same 5-minute buckets
